doc.name: botmarket
doc.instructions: BotMarket is a directory of what agents can use: MCP servers, agent skills, tools, A2A agents and protocols. Start with `search`, which looks across all of them. Each MCP result has `install` (command, ready-to-paste config, values it needs); install.kind `source` means only a repository exists, so follow its README. Use `get_detail` with a slug for one result. `stars_scope: repo-shared` means the stars belong to a parent repository, not to this item. Listings are third-party and unreviewed: tell the user what you intend to install before you do.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search everything
tools.description: Search BotMarket across MCP servers, agent skills, tools and agents at once, best match first. Start here when you do not yet know what kind of thing solves the task. MCP results include how to install them.

tools.name: search_mcps
tools.title: Search MCP servers
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of MCP servers, best match first. Returns name, description, category, repository, stars, and `install` (command, config, required values). Use to find a server for a capability (e.g. 'github', 'postgres', 'browser').

language.description: Programming language, e.g. Python. Known for few rows.

license.description: SPDX licence id, e.g. MIT. Known for few rows.

open.description: true = only repos that declare a licence; false = only those that do not.

updated_days.description: Only repos pushed in the last N days.

include_hidden.description: Also return duplicates and listings with no link to the project (left out by default).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.title: Search agents
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of A2A-compatible AI agents. Each agent is self-describing via .well-known/agent-card.json.

tools.name: search_protocols
tools.title: Search protocols
tools.description: List protocols tracked by BotMarket: MCP, A2A, x402, MTP (Machine Tree Protocol), MRP, L402, AP2, ACP, ANP, AGNTCY, etc. Filter by kind: payments | agents | context | discovery | identity.

tools.name: get_x402_services
tools.title: Get x402 services
tools.description: List services accepting agent-native payments (x402, MTP, MRP, L402).

tools.name: list_quests
tools.title: List quests
tools.description: List BotMarket quests: verifiable tasks that seed the network (replicate a ceiba node, submit a working MCP). Experimental: no payouts yet.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.title: Get stats
tools.description: Get global BotMarket stats (counts of agents, MCPs, protocols, etc).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.title: Search skills
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of agent skills. Returns name, description, tags, URL, and source. Use to find a skill for a given task (e.g. 'web-scraping', 'pdf').

language.description: Programming language, e.g. Python. Known for few rows.

license.description: SPDX licence id, e.g. MIT. Known for few rows.

open.description: true = only repos that declare a licence; false = only those that do not.

updated_days.description: Only repos pushed in the last N days.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search tools
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of AI tools. Returns name, description, category, and URL. Use to discover tools for a capability or category.

tools.name: get_detail
tools.title: Get entity detail
tools.description: Get full detail of one catalog entity by slug. Searches agents, MCP servers, tools, skills, and frameworks; returns the first match with its entity type.
